root_cause: The existing original source-to-obligation recovery planner silently skipped overdue channels if their original row was absent/ambiguous, advanced, duplicated or malformed; the existing PostgREST CAS used eq(field,null), which cannot be relied on for SQL NULL filtering. CAS zero-row outcomes were counted as conflicts without independent original-row receiver readback. Thus some recoverable original handoffs could appear to fall out of the owner action path without a durable typed diagnostic.
prevention: Use original nullable PostgREST .is() predicate, original CAS status/tenant/date/account gates, exact read-only receiver check for zero-row updates, original-owner routes for all due items, existing ONE BRAIN failure/brain_records and Heartbeat evidence; no scheduler stop, external retry without independent side-effect readback, new worker, direct Meta send, unauthorized email, or false-green.

evidence.source: actual original Supabase production query and existing GitHub main contract

not_proven: all historic due obligations terminal readback
